title: Effects of Borassus flabellifer L. fruit seed coat on HSC-3 cell line
author: Celine Chelsea Hartono
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare extract dilution series
steps.instruction: Make B. flabellifer fruit seed coat extract solutions at 93.75 µg/mL, 187.5 µg/mL, 375 µg/mL, 750 µg/mL, and 1,500 µg/mL in the appropriate cell culture medium.

steps.title: Prepare control solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare a negative control consisting of DMEM with 20 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) and a positive control containing Doxorubicin at 3 µM.

steps.title: Treat HSC-3 cells with samples
steps.instruction: Add each extract concentration, the negative control medium, and the Doxorubicin positive control to separate wells containing HSC-3 cell cultures.

steps.title: Perform CCK-8 viability assay
steps.instruction: Add CCK‑8 reagent to each well according to the reagent’s instructions and incubate for the time recommended by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Measure absorbance at 450 nm
steps.instruction: Read each well on a microplate reader set to 450 nm wavelength to record the optical density of formazan, which reflects cell viability.
